Info

Converts Cartesian waypoints into discrete motor joint steps with timing.

class scaralang.core.service.compiler.binary.step.step_discretizer.StepDiscretizer(*, kinematics: IKinematicsService, transmission: IJointStepTransmissionConverter)[source]¶

Bases: object

Discretizes Cartesian motion waypoints into hardware motor step coordinates.

It defines:

attributes:
_kinematics - Analytical SCARA kinematics calculation engine.
_transmission - Injected bidirectional transmission converter.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes step discretizer with kinematics and transmission.
discretize_waypoint - Solves IK and maps Cartesian waypoint into JointSteps.
calculate_segment_duration - Computes execution duration in microseconds.
angles_to_steps - Converts joint radians/mm to integer motor steps.
_kinematics: IKinematicsService¶
_transmission: IJointStepTransmissionConverter¶
angles_to_steps(theta1_rad: float, theta2_rad: float, z_mm: float, theta4_rad: float) → tuple[int, int, int, int][source]¶

Converts joint angles and linear Z travel into discrete motor steps.

Parameters:

  • theta1_rad – Shoulder joint angle in radians.

  • theta2_rad – Elbow joint angle in radians.

  • z_mm – Linear vertical travel in millimeters.

  • theta4_rad – Wrist joint angle in radians.

Returns:

Tuple of (j1, j2, z, j4) integer microsteps.

calculate_segment_duration(*, current_steps: tuple[int, int, int, int], target_steps: tuple[int, int, int, int], speed_mm_s: float) → int[source]¶

Computes segment execution duration in microseconds.

Parameters:

  • current_steps – Initial joint step coordinates.

  • target_steps – Target joint step coordinates.

  • speed_mm_s – Planned linear tool speed in mm/s.

Returns:

Microsecond execution duration.

Exceptions:

None.

discretize_waypoint(*, waypoint: Waypoint, prev_angles: tuple[float, float, float, float]) → tuple[JointSteps, tuple[float, float, float, float]][source]¶

Solves IK and converts Cartesian waypoint into motor steps with duration.

Parameters:

  • waypoint – Target Cartesian Waypoint instance.

  • prev_angles – Preceding joint angles (th1, th2, z, th4).

Returns:

Tuple of (JointSteps model, new joint angles tuple).

Exceptions:

ScaraKinematicsError if position is unreachable.
